hero.description: a gaunt undead skeleton warrior in a battered iron bucket helm with a narrow eye slit, a long ragged dark-red cape and scarf, rusted pauldrons, holding a long two-handed greatsword, dark fantasy, side view game sprite

run.action: running fast, a full sprint cycle, greatsword held low at his side, cape streaming behind

idle.action: standing in a battle-ready guard, breathing slowly, greatsword held ready in front, cape stirring

sprint.action: sprinting at full speed, leaning forward, long powerful strides, greatsword held back low, cape streaming far behind

jump.action: leaping upward, knees tucked, greatsword raised, cape flaring

fall.action: falling through the air, legs reaching down, cape billowing upward

roll.action: a fast forward combat roll, tucked into a ball, tumbling forward and rising back to his feet
